title: Air Conditioning — Recirculation — Install the Quarter Turn Filter Housing and the Sealed Manifold

issue.reason: Issue B. Earlier issues are not held in this dataset.

abstract: Installs the quarter turn recirculation filter housing and the sealed cabin air manifold, so that a filter change no longer breaks the manifold joint and no longer produces the whistle that follows an imperfect reseal.

sections.planning_reason: Filter changes at the six month interval disturb the manifold joint immediately downstream, and about one change in five produces a whistle reported by the cabin crew on the next sector. Line stations were resealing the joint outside any published task, with varying sealant. Nine operators raised the point at the technical review and it stayed in the cabin dissatisfaction top ten for two years running.
sections.description: This bulletin replaces the filter housing with the quarter turn variant, whose cover allows the element to be changed without breaking the manifold joint, and replaces the manifold with the kit item carrying an integrated flange seal in place of the separate collar. The downstream restrictor and the recirculation sensor are retained.
sections.accomplishment_summary: Open the ceiling void access panels at the recirculation position and support the ducting. Remove the existing filter housing and the manifold, and remove all traces of the old collar and sealant from the flange faces. Install the kit manifold with its integrated seal, aligning the flange to the marks and torquing in the sequence given. Install the quarter turn housing and check that the cover swings clear within the ceiling void clearance stated in the bulletin, which revision two corrects for the aft installation. Fit a new filter element, do the cleaning and airflow check in AMM-M-21-20-13-100-052-A, and do a leak check at maximum flow. Refit the access panels and make the records entry. Repeat on the opposite side.
sections.effectivity_note: Applies to MERIDIAN-42 and MERIDIAN-46 aircraft between MSN M00102 and M00412 that have not embodied MOD-168276 in production, excluding MSN M00263. Both sides must be embodied at the same visit so that the filter change task applies uniformly.
sections.material_note: Kit is per aircraft and contains two housings, two manifolds, the seal set and two filter elements for the initial fit. The removed manifolds are scrapped locally. Revision two corrects the ceiling void clearance figure for the aft installation, which was quoted from the forward drawing in the first issue.

type_data.compliance_time: At any A check within 36 months of the date of this Service Bulletin.

revision_history.reason: Ceiling void clearance figure corrected for the aft installation in step 4
